verdict: No blocking provenance or format-normalization flaw found; interpretation must remain narrow.
findings: Qwen3 native ON/OFF comparison is the strongest result: 90 valid pairs after explicitly post-hoc single-fence normalization; strict primary has only two OFF-valid responses.
Qwen3.5 has completion-dependent selection: 14 valid ON responses and 76 truncations. Matching does not remove this missingness. Conditional forecasts and response yield must be reported separately.
Only complete models may be compared. At review time Qwen3.8 ON collection remained incomplete.
The intervention is the native explicit-thinking mode under a common output cap. It does not isolate all internal reasoning, latent beliefs, alignment or forecasting accuracy.
Ninety draws from three paraphrases are generation samples, not independent model/training replicates.
The median paired difference is distinct from the difference of the two plotted medians.
Within-checkpoint mode effects do not establish why forecasts differ by model release date; checkpoint, training, knowledge, architecture and date framing remain confounded.
